items.title: Ray Drummond interviewed by Monk Rowe, Toronto, Canada, January 9, 2003
items.q: For a time Billy Hart and I used to play together in Kenny’s trio

ctx.x: Do you write at the piano?

Yeah I write at the piano, can write at the bass, sometimes write without anything around. That doesn’t happen very often but it has happened a couple of times where all of a sudden something comes to me and I just write it out. But the piano has probably been the resource that I’ve used the most for composing. One of these days I’m going to get Finale totally under my fingers. That’ll become a composing tool for me. Finale, Sibelius or one of those programs. Because they’ve become highly evolved now and they can…
I was looking at your website and —
